description: Publish a tool of a registered kind (e.g. python, http or echo; the kind argument's enum lists them all) under this tenant's namespace. Call host.quickstart(kind) first for a filled-in example spec and the full publish-to-call sequence. Python's sandbox API: import mcphost (mcphost.table, mcphost.state, mcphost.docs). Name must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,40}$; a rejection names the failing field and a corrected example. Try host.tool_test before a real call.

dry_run.description: return the diff this call would make and commit nothing

kind.description: Which registered kind to publish under: one of this field's `enum` (host.quickstart with no kind lists every kind, alias and recipe). A job-word alias in the enum also resolves here -- webhook-style words for an inbound webhook, cron-style words for a timed run -- both resolve to kind http and the descriptor comes back with resolved_from naming the alias you asked for. Error contract per kind: chain (families: compose, tool_state; source_line: no); echo (families: none; source_line: no); http (families: upstream; source_line: no); jq (families: tool_code, tool_limit; source_line: no); js (families: tool_code, tool_limit, upstream, compose, tool_state; source_line: yes); python (families: tool_code, tool_limit, upstream, compose, tool_state; source_line: yes); wasm (families: tool_code, tool_limit; source_line: no).

name.description: Local name for the new tool; must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,40}$.

scopes.description: OAuth scopes a token must carry (directly, or via mcp) to reach this tool: catalogued names from host.oauth.scopes, or the built-ins read/write. At most 8. Omit (or [] ) to require only mcp -- unaffected by any catalog.

spec.description: The kind-specific spec object; see host.quickstart(kind) for a filled-in example. For python's network field: "none" (every plan), "public" (requires the pro plan), "egress" (requires the pro plan) -- a tool's own code reaches this tenant's data with `import mcphost` (mcphost.table, mcphost.state, mcphost.docs, mcphost.lineage) even when network is "none".

tags.description: Catalog tags: at most 16, each 1-32 chars of a-z, 0-9 and '-', stored lower-case and deduped.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Optional on the connection that ran signup (or host.redeem): that connection is already bound to the tenant it created, so later calls on it need no tenant_key. On a connection with no Authorization: Bearer header and no prior signup, omitting it implicitly signs that connection up as a brand-new tenant and runs this call as it -- see host.whoami's source field. When both a header and this argument are present, the header wins.

visibility.description: Who may find the tool (default private). unlisted: callable by full name and readable by host.catalog.get, never listed. public: listed in the catalog, and refused (untested_tool_cannot_be_public) unless the current version passes its dry run first. Use host.tool_share for group or url.

name: host.tool_publish

call_line.description: A ready-to-paste call for the published tool. Optional: declared so a typed client reserves the field; absent from responses that do not carry one.

tool_lint.description: Advisory publish-time lint findings for a python tool ([] when clean); a finding never blocks the publish.

version.description: The tool's version after this publish (1 for a first publish).
